title: The Long Workings
objective: Clear whatever has taken the old workings, down to the deep hall.

entries.omen: Claws skitter somewhere in the dark.

rooms.name: Adit Mouth
rooms.description: A timbered tunnel mouth in the hillside. Rails run into the dark.

features.name: Tally Board
features.description: A board of chalked tallies by the rails.
features.discovery: The last tally is crossed out, and under it is chalked: "Shaft shut. Use the chute."

rooms.name: Lamp Room
rooms.description: Shelves of dead lamps line a cramped side room.

features.name: Lamp Shelves
features.description: Rows of lamps, most of them cracked.
features.discovery: Behind the last lamp stands a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Guard Post
rooms.description: A widening of the tunnel with a brazier and two stools.

rooms.name: Tool Store
rooms.description: Picks and shovels hang on pegs over a strongbox, its hasp rusted through.

features.name: Strongbox
features.description: A strongbox with a rusted hasp.
features.discovery: A few coins rattle in the bottom of the box.

items.name: Handful of Coins
items.description: A few silver and gold coins.

rooms.name: Bunkroom
rooms.description: Rows of plank bunks. The door bars from inside.

features.name: Footlocker
features.description: A footlocker under the end bunk.
features.discovery: Inside, wrapped in a shirt, is a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Ore Chute
rooms.description: A steep chute drops away into the lower workings, slick with ore dust.

rooms.name: Collapsed Drift
rooms.description: A side drift half filled by a roof fall. Something growls behind the rubble.

features.name: Roof Fall
features.discovery: Under a timber lies a miner's silver cup.

rooms.name: Foreman's Office
rooms.description: A plank office with a desk and a ledger.

features.name: Foreman's Desk
features.discovery: In the drawer is an iron key on a nail and a purse of coins.

items.name: Winch-House Key
items.description: An iron key on a nail.

rooms.name: Winch House
rooms.description: A great winch stands over a cage shaft. Kobolds have made it a den.

rooms.name: Shaft Head
rooms.description: The top of the cage shaft, where a ladder runs down beside the cables.

rooms.name: Shaft Foot
rooms.description: The bottom of the shaft, ankle-deep in seepage.

rooms.name: Pump Room
rooms.description: A dry room round an old beam pump. A stout door shuts it off.

features.name: Pump Housing
features.description: The rusted housing of the pump.
features.discovery: Tucked inside the housing is a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

rooms.name: Old Shrine
rooms.description: A niche with a miner's saint carved in the rock.

features.name: Saint's Niche
features.description: Offerings lie at the carving's feet.
features.discovery: Among the offerings is a small polished stone.

rooms.name: Flooded Gallery
rooms.description: A long gallery under a foot of black water.

rooms.name: Sump
rooms.description: The lowest point of the gallery, where silt has gathered.

features.name: Silt Bank
features.discovery: Something glints: coins washed down from above.

rooms.name: Cave-In
rooms.description: A tunnel ends at a wall of fallen stone.

rooms.name: Crystal Cave
rooms.description: A natural cave glittering with quartz, hung with old webs.

rooms.name: Ore Vault
rooms.description: A strongroom cut for the best ore. Bones stir by the chests.

features.name: Ore Chests
features.discovery: One chest holds a gemstone the size of a thumb.

rooms.name: Bone Stair
rooms.description: A stair cut down into older rock, littered with bones.

rooms.name: Deep Hall
rooms.description: A vaulted hall where the old miners broke into something older.

passages.description: A side door off the adit.
A short passage to a barred door.
An iron gate to the cage shaft.
The ladder down beside the cables.
A crack in the gallery wall.
A cut passage, its door long gone.

opponents.name: Dead Guard
opponents.description: The post's guard, long dead, lurches off its stool.

opponents.name: Vault Skeleton
opponents.description: A skeleton rises to guard the chests.

opponents.name: Drift Wolf
opponents.description: A lean wolf slinks out of the rubble.

opponents.name: Winch Hand
opponents.description: A dead winchman turns from the winch.

opponents.name: Drowned Miner
opponents.description: A drowned miner rises from the water.

opponents.name: Deep Chief
opponents.description: A goblin chief rises from a heap of furs, scimitar drawn.

opponents.name: Deep Rat
opponents.description: A rat scuttles out of the dark.

endings.title: The workings cleared
endings.text: The goblin chief falls in the deep hall, and the workings are quiet.

endings.title: Out with your finds
endings.text: You climb out of the workings with what you found.

endings.title: Out of the workings
endings.text: You leave the workings with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Fallen in the workings
endings.text: You fall in the dark of the workings. Your adventuring ends here.
